flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open the Kern demo store.
Click the button labelled 'Load $60.00 eligible cart'.
Read the amount shown on the line starting with 'Shipping' and store it as {{observed_shipping}}.
Read the amount shown on the line starting with 'Merchandise subtotal' and store it as {{observed_subtotal}}.
Then verify {{observed_shipping}} is $0.00.

remark: click: Clicking the Load $60.00 eligible cart button
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the Shipping quote heading to be visible
analyze: ANALYZE(visual, "The amount shown on the line starting with 'Merchandise subtota

summary:
The store applied a shipping charge even though the cart subtotal was $60.00 and the store says US orders of $50.00 or more receive free standard shipping.
Fix the free-shipping rule so US standard-shipping carts with an after-discount merchandise subtotal of $50.00 or more show $0.00 shipping, then add a regression check for the $60.00 eligible-cart fixture.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Shipping — Standard (3–5 business days) $9.00
evidence: objective_contradiction: Merchandise subtotal (after discounts) $60.00
evidence: objective_contradiction: Free standard shipping on US orders of $50.00 or more. After-discount merchandise subtotal, USD, standard shipping.
one_liner: The $60 eligible cart showed a $9.00 standard-shipping charge instead of free shipping.
